wholeCorpusComparisonGroups.comparisonBasis: Within-city task development plus cross-city bank, transport, food/shop, medical-intake, postal, public-space and information-support scripts already read. Repeated safety/verification vocabulary alone does not imply the same causal plot.

targetedTextRepairs.withdrawnStaleFinding: E08 referred to a discarded Kaizu04 wallet draft; final prevention-notice script read independently.

selectedFullSemanticComparisons.decision: Old overtime/head-heavy duplicate rejected; current Yamagata script explains 再来 reception terminology and prior-visit/different-current-complaint intake. Independent trigger and action.

Passbook annotation permission with separate-note alternative; withdrawal denomination breakdown; selected cash deposit with form; sorting collected coins before fee/amount choice. Each has a different operative banking request and outcome.

Initial mixed two-person purchase requests separate bags and card checkout; existing paid bread transfer to still-shopping spouse tracks paid/unpaid ownership. Different payment stage and interaction problem.

Course application steps and callback hours; mistaken approved-result message and handling return call; community poster content approval/contact hours/removal date. Shared municipal support setting, distinct process objectives and role responses.

Statement issuance preparation and receipt questions; purpose classification of bank transactions against receipts; address-change discussion postponed until family confirms address. Topic-specific task paths distinguish record/sequence vocabulary.
Unlocated park coat inquiry; known clinic coat identity/pickup arrangements; hospital wheelchair return revealing retained coat. Inquiry stage, object and NPC authority distinct.

Combining story letters; intentionally separate daily postings; physical letter chain to three recipients; protecting unfolded child artwork. Different postal objective and preparation rather than noun replacement.

Wait for friend searching forgotten book; depart alone after friend cancels; buy two destinations for shared initial train. Opposite travel decisions supported by different constraints, not one generic rider plot.

crossPrefectureEvidence.scope: Earlier selected full scripts in cluster review files and own bounded review reused; no assertion all prior authored corpus read.

rationale: Accept scoped AI Japanese editorial gate: all181 are individually authored, 11-turn alternating exchanges with five task-aligned goals and NPC farewell/handoff closure. Actual omissions of basic meanings/own-offered answers were repaired. Eight abstract defensive conversations were fully replaced with usable operations. The demonstrated repeated overtime plot was fully replaced. Some reflection/caution remains in the other scripts, but read in their particular contexts it clarifies a real report, permission or misunderstanding; it is not by itself an open whole-plot duplication finding. No concrete unresolved blocker remains after these repairs. Automated scores are supporting screening, never the acceptance rationale.
nonBlockingLimitations: Some wording is deliberately explanatory for learners; native editorial polish is not certified.
Fictional sums, stock, room/contact procedures and equipment are simulation settings, not promises by real facilities.
Dedicated specialist NPC/scene artwork and device rendering checks remain outside this text gate.
Full prior-corpus semantic uniqueness cannot be proven by selected comparisons.

lateGateReview.currentTitle: 昼休みが短くなり銀行アプリ相談の予約日を変える
currentTurnsRead: ご予約についてのお電話ですね。

お名前と、ご予約の相談内容を教えてください。
グエンです。銀行のアプリを初めて使うため、最初の操作を教えてもらう予約です。
確認できました。明日の三時でしたら、相談枠をご案内できます。
三時は仕事中です。明後日は休みなので、午前の枠があればそちらに移したいです。
明後日の十時に空きがあります。ご都合はいかがですか。
十時でお願いします。スマートフォンも持って行きます。途中で仕事へ戻らなくてよいので、落ち着いて質問できます。
明後日の十時に変更しました。元の明日一時の予約は取り消します。
ありがとうございます。自分の予定表も書き換えます。明日は来店せず、明後日の十時前に受付で名前を伝えます。
新しい日時でお待ちしております。それでは、当日お気をつけてお越しください。
